title: Mobility patterns accept NaN/inf and RandomWaypoint validates nothing - silent position corruption
description: Found in 3x codereview of uory fix. (1) RandomWaypoint has no __post_init__ validation at all (speed<=0, bounds, pause) unlike its three siblings. (2) NaN bypasses the 'x <= 0' checks in all four patterns (nan <= 0 is False): speed_m_s=nan or NaN bounds construct cleanly and poison geometry - max_distance >= distance is False for NaN, flow falls into the ratio branch and writes NaN into node.set_position, propagating silently through every later distance/sqrt. (3) speed_m_s=inf passes validation; every arrival charges distance/inf*1e6 == 0.0 so each step() burns the full 100k iteration cap (bounded ~0.1-0.3s/node/tick hostile-scenario amplification). Fix: add RandomWaypoint validation matching siblings; use math.isfinite on speed/spacing/bounds/pause across all four patterns.
acceptance_criteria: constructing any pattern with NaN/inf speed, spacing, or bounds raises ValueError; existing valid configs unchanged
